subject: DS474
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selections are strong, with highly relevant and authoritative sources for all topics. The Arabic selections are also strong, though the pool of candidates was smaller for some topics. For 'Data Quality', only one Arabic video passed the gates. For 'Data Storytelling', no Arabic video passed the hard gates, primarily due to low view counts or low relevance.

coverage.note: Most candidates failed the view count gate. The selected video was the only one to pass all hard gates.
All candidates failed hard gates, primarily due to low view counts, low relevance (general storytelling), or being in English.

videos.title: Data Quality Explained
videos.filter_reason: A concise, highly-viewed explanation of data quality from a very reputable source (IBM), making it an excellent introduction.

videos.title: StatQuest: Logistic Regression
videos.filter_reason: StatQuest is a premier educational resource known for exceptional clarity; this video is the gold standard for explaining logistic regression.

videos.title: What is Time Series Analysis?
videos.filter_reason: This IBM video provides a clear, authoritative, and highly-viewed introduction to what time series are and the analytics they enable.

videos.title: Beyond the Numbers: A Data Analyst Journey | Anna Leach | TEDxPSU
videos.filter_reason: This video offers tool-agnostic dashboard design best practices, has a high view count, and is from a company specializing in dashboards.

videos.title: Telling Stories with Data in 3 Steps (Quick Study)
videos.filter_reason: A short, high-impact, and authoritative explanation from Harvard Business Review that provides a memorable framework for data storytelling.

videos.title: كيفية تحسين جودة البيانات للذكاء الاصطناعي ب استعمال Z test
videos.filter_reason: This was the only candidate to pass all hard gates, offering a practical guide to improving data quality using a statistical test.

videos.title: تعلم اساسيات الانحدار الوجستي 1, logistic regression explained in arabic
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly relevant and the most-viewed eligible video, providing a strong theoretical foundation for logistic regression in Arabic.

videos.title: مبادئ الإحصاء  - طرق قياس الاتجاه العام للسلسلة الزمنية
videos.filter_reason: With a very high view count, this video is a well-vetted introduction to the fundamental concepts of time series analysis.

videos.title: تصميم لوحة تفاعلية على برنامج Power BI Dashboard 01
videos.filter_reason: A very popular and high-quality tutorial that walks through building a dashboard in Power BI, a key industry tool for visual analytics.
